name: Rogue
description: A lightning-fast assassin who exploits enemy weaknesses with critical strikes and poison.
lore: The Shadow Market produces killers of unmatched precision. Rogues don't fight fair — they fight to win, striking vital points before the enemy knows they're there.

abilities.name: Backstab
abilities.description: A precise strike at a vital point. +15% bonus crit chance.

abilities.name: Poison Blade
abilities.description: Coats blade in venom. Reduced initial damage but poisons for 4% max HP/turn for 3 turns.

abilities.name: Evasion
abilities.description: Heightens reflexes, granting +50% dodge chance for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Ambush
abilities.description: 2.5x damage. If target has any debuff, 3.75x instead.

abilities.name: Smoke Bomb
abilities.description: All enemies have 35% miss chance for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Blade Dance
abilities.description: Passive: 20% chance to strike twice. +10% crit rate.

abilities.name: Death Mark
abilities.description: Ultimate: 3x damage. Target takes 25% more from all sources for 3 turns. Executed instantly if they drop below 20% HP.

synergies: Warrior: Taunt keeps aggro off the Rogue
Mage: Frost Nova slow counts as a debuff for Ambush bonus
Ranger: Hunter's Mark + Death Mark stacks for massive focus damage
weaknesses: Relies on debuffs to maximize damage
Low INT means zero magic defense contribution
hire_description: You almost don't notice the hooded figure until a dagger embeds itself in the notice board beside you. "Looking for someone who gets results? I don't ask questions if you don't."
